about: The Queen sends her son to Solomon in the care of her merchant Tamrin, with provisions and a message: the throne of Ethiopia is to pass henceforth to a male of Solomon's line, idolatry is forbidden, and she asks for a relic of Zion. At Gaza, a city said to be Ethiopian, which the chronicle links to Acts 8, the people take the boy for Solomon himself and rush to honor him. Couriers sent to Jerusalem find the real king and describe the stranger, who is the image of Solomon and David. Solomon, troubled, recalls that God has foiled his plan to father many sons, as Paul says, and the chapter closes on the oath to David and the Ethiopian king as heir of Zion.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፴ወ፫ is 33 (spoken ሠላሳ ወሠለስቱ, śälasa wä-śälästu); the ወ inside the numeral is 'and', as in ፳ወ፪ elsewhere. ዘከመ 'how' (ዘ- + ከመ, 'in the manner that') introduces the account; ወረደ 'he went down' (ወረደ 'descend'); the heading does not say where, and I take it as the boy's journey down toward Palestine (?). ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ 'king of Ethiopia' is a title given to him in advance, since the chapter is about him (and, in the story's view, the future king). Construct chain: ንጉሠ 'king of' + ኢትዮጵያ 'Ethiopia'.

sentences.l: And-she-summoned-him to-Tamrin chief-of her-merchants, and-she-said-to-him: Prepare for-your-journey and-take this son, for he-wearied-me night and-day exceedingly by-his-ሕቁ (?);
sentences.i: She summoned Tamrin, the chief of her merchants, and said to him: "Make ready for your journey and take this son, for he has worn me out, night and day, exceedingly, by his ሕቁ (?);
sentences.n: ወጸውዐቶ 'and she summoned him' (ጸውዐ 'call', 3rd feminine singular perfect, + -ቶ 'him'); ለተምሪን: ለ- marks the object here, as it often does with persons (the accusative sign, not 'to'). ሊቀ ነጋድያኒሃ 'chief of her merchants' (ሊቅ 'chief' in the construct, ነጋድያን plural of ነጋዲ 'merchant' + -ሃ 'her'). ወትበሎ is the spelling of ወትቤሎ 'and she said to him' (as ይበላ was read in ch. 31). ተደለው 'prepare!' (imperative of ተደለወ) with ለመንግድከ 'for your journey' (መንግድ 'road, journey'); ወውስዶ 'and take him!' (imperative of ወሰደ). እስመ አጽሐበኒ is uncertain: I take አጽሐበ as 'wore out, wearied' from context, with -ኒ 'me' (?). ሌሊተ ወመዐልተ 'by night and by day' (accusatives of time); ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. በሕቁ is unclear to me: I cannot place it and give no sense for it; the English leaves it in Geʿez (?). The speaker is the Queen; Tamrin is the caravan-leader of ch. 7 onward.

sentences.i: and bring him to the king, and bring him back here safely, if God, the God of Israel, wills it."
sentences.n: ወታበጽሖ 'and bring him' (አበጽሐ, causative of በጽሐ 'arrive': 'cause to arrive', 2nd masculine imperfect used as a command, + -ኦ 'him', merged into the final ሖ); ወታገብኦ 'and bring him back' (አግብአ 'return' transitively). በዳኅን 'in safety' (ዳኅን 'safe'). ለእመ ሠምረ እግዚኣብሔር 'if God is pleased, wills' (ለእመ 'if'; ሠምረ 'be pleased, will'). sentences.l: And-she-prepared provision according-to their-wealth and-their-honor, and-all goods which is-needed for-journey, and-which is-given gift to-king, and-which will-be rest(?) for-journey;
sentences.i: She prepared provisions suited to their wealth and rank, and all the goods needed for the road, those to be given as a gift to the king and those that would ease the journey;
sentences.n: ተደለወት 'she prepared' (ተደለወ, feminine perfect; the same verb as the imperative ተደለው above). ሥንቀ 'provisions' (accusative). በከመ ብዕሎሙ ወክብሮሙ 'according to their wealth and their honor': ብዕል 'wealth', ክብር 'honor, rank', + -ሙ 'their'. ዘይትፈቀድ 'which is needed' (ዘ- relative + ተፈቀደ 'be needed, be wanted', a passive-reflexive imperfect), ዘይትወሀብ 'which is given' (ተወሀበ 'be given'), ዘይከውን 'which will be' (ኮነ). አምኃ 'gift, tribute' (accusative; the word recurs in unit 20). ዕረፍተ ለፍኖት 'rest for the road' (ዕረፍት 'rest, relief'); I read 'something to ease the journey'. The three ዘ- clauses are in a list, each describing the goods.

sentences.i: She made everything ready to send him off, and she gave also to the nobles who were going with him, and gave them much of what was needed for the road.
sentences.n: ወአስተዳለወት 'and she made ready' (አስተዳለወ, a causative-reflexive of the same root as ተደለወ). ከመ ትፈንዎ 'that she might send him' (ፈነወ 'send', subjunctive 3rd feminine, + -ዎ 'him'). ወወሀበት ለመኳንንትኒ: መኳንንት 'nobles, officers' (plural of መኰንን); ለ- marks the recipient; the enclitic -ኒ is 'also, indeed'. እለ የሐውሩ 'who go' (እለ is the plural relative 'those who', የሐውሩ imperfect of ሖረ); ምስሌሁ 'with him'. ወሀበቶሙ 'she gave them' (ወሀበ + -ቶሙ). ብዙኀ ንዋየ 'much goods' (ንዋይ 'goods, equipment', accusative).

sentences.l: And-she-commanded-them that not they-leave-him there, her-son, but they-hand-over(?)-him to-king and-bring-him-back to-her, and-that he-appoint kingdom-too for-her-land;
sentences.i: She commanded them not to leave her son there, but to present (?) him to the king and bring him back to her, and that the king should also establish a kingship for her land (?).
sentences.n: ወአዘዘቶሙ 'and she commanded them' (አዘዘ 'command'). ከመ ኢይኅድግዎ 'that they not leave him' (ኀደገ 'leave', + -ዎ 'him'); ለወልዳ 'her son' (ለ- the object marker again, as with ለተምሪን; ወልድ + -ኣ 'her'). አላ ባሕቱ 'but rather'. ያገብርዎ ለንጉሥ: አግበረ in the sense 'present, hand over' is a guess (?); the usual sense 'compel, subject' fits badly, so the text may be corrupt here. ወያግብእዎ ኀቤሃ 'and bring him back to her' (አግብአ + ኀበ 'to' + -ሃ 'her'). ወከመ ይሢም 'and that he appoint' (ሠየመ 'appoint'), subject unstated: I take it as Solomon, who in the story later anoints the boy (?). መንግሥተኒ 'a kingdom also'; the paragraph ends with ፨, which I read as a unit mark, not a full stop of the speech. The sense may be that Solomon is to appoint a kingship for her land (?), which would set up the law of succession in the next unit.

sentences.l: for it-was its-ordinance, of-land-of Ethiopia: she-reigns woman virgin who not she-took-a-husband man;
sentences.i: For it was the custom of the land of Ethiopia that a virgin woman should reign, one who had not taken a husband;
sentences.n: እስመ ኮነ ሥርዐታ ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'for it was the custom of the land of Ethiopia': ሥርዐት 'order, custom, ordinance'; the suffix -ኣ is the anticipatory pronoun before the ለ- genitive ('its ordinance, that of the land of Ethiopia'), as in መጋቢሃ ... ለኵሉ ብሔረ ጋዛ in unit 17. ትነግሥ ብእሲት ድንግል 'a virgin woman reigns' (ነግሠ 'reign', 3rd feminine imperfect; a bare imperfect after ኮነ ሥርዐታ gives 'that she should reign'). እንተ ኢያውሰበት ብእሴ 'who did not take a husband' (እንተ 'who' feminine relative; ኢያውሰበት: አውሰበ is said of the man 'taking a wife', so this use for a woman 'taking' a husband is unusual (?); ብእሴ 'a man', accusative). This is the book's account of a custom of a virgin queen, which the Queen is now about to change.

sentences.i: And she said: "From now on let a male of your kin reign, and let no woman ever reign, but only this kinsman of yours and his offspring, from generation to generation;
sentences.n: The unit is the Queen's message (to Solomon, I take it: 'your kin' = Solomon's line (?)). Orthography: the words ይእዘሰአ, ይንገሥአ, ተባዕትአ, ዘመድከአ (twice), ብእሲትአ and ዓለምአ all end in an unexplained extra አ; I cannot explain it; I treat it as a scribal or printing mark with no bearing on the translation, and translate the stems (እምይእዘሰ 'from now indeed': እም- 'from' + ይእዘ, Bezold's spelling of ይእዜ 'now', + -ሰ; ይንገሥ 'let him reign', jussive; ተባዕት 'male'; ዘመድ 'kin, relative' + -ከ 'your'; ብእሲት 'woman'; ዓለም 'eternity, world'; ለዓለም 'forever'). ዘእንበለ ዝንቱ ዘመድከ is awkward: ዘእንበለ 'apart from, except' followed by 'this your kinsman' suggests 'let none reign except this one and his seed', but the syntax joins loosely to the previous clause, so the exact sense is a little uncertain (?). ለትውልደ ትውልድ 'for generation of generation' (a common idiom of unending time).

sentences.n: Corrupt or obscure in several words. ወትልክኣ: the verb is ትልክ- with a stray -ኣ; it may be ትልእክ- 'you send' (ለአከ) + -ኣ 'it' with the ክ and እ transposed, which gives 'send it to a scroll'; a verb ልከአ 'inscribe, write' I cannot confirm, so the English 'have it written' is only a guess (?). ኀበ መጽሐፈ ጦማር 'into a book, a scroll' (መጽሐፍ 'book, writing', ጦማር 'scroll, roll'). ውስተ መጽሐፈ ነቢያቲሆሙ 'within the book of their prophets'. ዘብርት 'which is of ብርት' is uncertain: ብርት may mean 'metal/bronze' or be a form of 'bright' (?); I have left it in Geʿez. ወታነብራ 'and you place it' (አንበረ 'place', + -ኣ). ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'the house of God' is the Jerusalem Temple (1 Kings 6). ዘተሐንጽ 'which was built' (ተሐነጸ passive of ሐነጸ 'build'; the spelling is shortened, final ጽ). ለተዝካር ወለትንቢት 'for a memorial and for prophecy' (ተዝካር 'memorial', ትንቢት 'prophecy'), ለደኃሪ መዋዕል 'for the last days' (ደኃሪ 'latter'; compare the 'last days' of the prophets).

sentences.i: and that they should not bow down to the sun or to the adornment of heaven (the stars), or to mountains and trees, or to stones and the trees of the wilderness, or to seas and what is in the water, or to carved images and golden likenesses, or to birds that fly, nor practice divination (?) by them, nor worship them;
sentences.n: This clause (ከመ ኢይስግዱ 'that they not bow down', ሰገደ 'bow, prostrate') is part of the Queen's decree: the prohibition of idolatry echoes Deuteronomy 4:15–19 and the second commandment (Exodus 20:4–5). Each ወኢለ- is 'nor to' (ለ- 'to' with ሰገደ). ወኢለአድባር 'nor to mountains' (አድባር plural of ደብር), ወአዕዋም 'and trees' (አዕዋም, uncertain (?)), ወኢለአእባን 'nor to stones' (አእባን plural of እብን). ሰርጐ ሰማይ: ሰርጕ 'ornament', so 'the adornment of the heavens', the stars. ዕፀወ ገዳም 'trees of the wilderness'. ቀላያት 'seas, depths'. ወለዘ ውስተ ማይ 'and to what is in the water' (ዘ 'that which'). ግልፈዋት 'carved images' (plural of ግልፈት 'engraving') (?). አምሳለ ወርቅ 'likeness of gold'. ኢለአዕዋፍ ዘይሰርር 'nor to birds which fly' (ዘይሰርር singular for the collective; ሰረረ here 'fly', as 'sped' in ch. 31). ወኢይጠየሩ ቦሙ: ጠየረ I remember from Dillmann as 'take omens' (from birds), which fits, but I could not check it here; but the plain sense 'turn to/ look to them' is also possible (?). ወኢያምልክዎሙ 'and not make gods of them, worship them' (አምለከ). The long list is an accumulation of parallel phrases with ወኢ- and ወ-.

sentences.i: But give us, from the edge (?) of her garment, the ዘንኤምኃ (?) for Zion, the holy, heavenly Ark of God's law;
sentences.n: A hard unit; the sense is a request to Solomon: ወባሕቱ ሀበነ 'but give us' (ሀበ 'give', imperative + -ነ 'us'). እምዘፈረ ልብሳ: እም- 'from', ልብስ 'garment' + -ኣ 'her' (Zion is feminine). ዘፈረ I cannot confirm; if it is ዘፈር 'edge, fringe' (unverified) the sense 'from the border of her garment' fits a request for a relic (?). ዘንኤምኃ is not a form I can resolve, perhaps a garbled relative + noun; I leave it in transliteration (?). ለጽዮን 'for Zion' (ጽዮን 'Zion'). ቅድስት ሰማያዊት 'holy, heavenly' (feminine adjectives). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the Ark of His law, of God': the Kebra Nagast identifies Zion with the Ark of the Covenant (ታቦት), earthly copy of a heavenly Zion; the request for a relic of Zion anticipates the Ark theme of the coming chapters. The reading of the whole unit is conjectural.

sentences.i: She took him aside, alone, and she gave him the sign that Solomon had given her, the ring from his fingers, so that Solomon might know my son and remember her word and the covenant she had made all the days of her life, to worship God, she and those under her rule, in all that God had given her.
sentences.n: ወአግሐሠቶ 'and she drew him aside' (the Queen is the subject, the boy the object; as in ch. 31, አግሐሠ). እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'by himself, alone' (the idiom of ch. 31; ባሕቲት 'solitude' + -ሁ). ወወሀበቶ ይእቲ 'and she, she gave him' (ይእቲ 'she' emphasizes the subject). ትእምርተ ዘወሀባ ሰሎሞን 'a sign which Solomon gave her' (the ring of ch. 31; ዘወሀባ is ዘ + ወሀበ + -ኣ). ሕልቀተ 'ring' in apposition. ከመ ያእምሮ ለወልዲ: ከመ + subjunctive 'that he may know' (አእመረ; the final -ኦ of ያእምሮ is 'him', anticipating ለወልዲ: 'that he know him, my son'), ወልዲ 'my son' (the Queen speaks in the first person here, a lapse from the narrative into her words; ወልድየ would be usual, ወልዲ is a variant or slip (?)). ወከመ ይዘከር 'and that he remember' (ተዘከረ 'remember', a passive-reflexive stem). ነገራ ወኪዳና 'her word and her covenant' (ኪዳን 'covenant'). ዘተካየደት 'which she covenanted' (ተካየደ 'make a covenant (with another)'). በኵሉ መዋዕለ ሕይወታ 'in all the days of her life'. ከመ ታምልኮ 'that she worship him, make him her god' (አምለከ). ወእለ እምታሕተ መንግሣታ 'and those under her rule' (እምታሕተ 'from under', i.e. 'subject to'). በኵሉ ዘወሀባ እግዚኣብሔር 'in all that God gave her'. The unit, at 32 words, is long but kept whole, since it has no ፤.

sentences.i: And in the Acts of the Apostles too, Luke the evangelist wrote, saying: he was its steward over all the land of Gaza, the eunuch (?) of the Queen of Candace; he is the one who believed through the word of Luke the apostle. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: The allusion is to Acts 8:26–40: Philip meets, on the road toward Gaza, an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official of 'Candace, queen of the Ethiopians', 'in charge of all her treasure' (Acts 8:27); he is baptized. As I remember the Geʿez Bible (unchecked), the word 'treasure' there is ጋዛ, the same letters as the city's name, and the Kebra Nagast reads it as the place Gaza (that is how it makes the official governor of 'all the land of Gaza' and Gaza Ethiopian). ወበውስተ ግብረ ሐዋርያትሂ 'and in the Acts of the Apostles too' (ግብር 'deed', -ሂ 'also'). ጸሐፈ ሉቃስ ወንጌላዊ 'Luke the evangelist wrote' (Luke is the traditional author of Acts). እንዘ ይብል 'saying'. መጋቢሃ ውእቱ 'he is its steward' (መጋቢ 'steward, manager'). ኅጽዋ 'eunuch': I take it as ኅጽው 'eunuch' (from memory of Dillmann; unchecked) with the final ዋ as ኅጽው + the 3rd feminine suffix -ኣ ('her'), anticipating ለንግሥተ ህንደኬ, the same construction as መጋቢሃ ... ለኵሉ ብሔረ ጋዛ. ንግሥተ ህንደኬ 'the queen of Candace' (Candace, ህንደኬ, is really a title of Meroitic queens, treated here as a name). ዘአምነ በቃለ ሉቃስ 'who believed through the word of Luke' (አምነ 'believe'). The text credits Luke's word, not Philip's, for the eunuch's belief; in Acts it is Philip who preaches to and baptizes him. The seven ፨ close chapter 33 and stay with the final unit.

sentences.n: ወሶበ ርእይዎ 'and when they saw him' (ርእየ, 3rd plural, + -ዎ). መሰሎሙ 'it seemed to them' (መሰለ 'be like, seem' with the dative suffix -ሙ 'to them'); ፍጹመ 'wholly, perfectly' (accusative of ፍጹም 'perfect'). The point: everyone takes the boy for Solomon. ሰገዲ ሎቱ 'they bowed to him' (ሰገዲ is a spelling of 3rd plural ሰገዱ, or an unmarked variant). ባሕ ሕየው አበ ነጋሢ: ባሕ I cannot place, perhaps a cry of greeting (?), and the English leaves it unrendered; ሕየው 'live!' (imperative of ሐይወ, in the ancient royal greeting 'live'); አበ ነጋሢ 'father of the king': ነጋሢ is an agent-noun 'one who reigns'; 'father of the king' addressed to Solomon makes sense (he is Menelik's father) but is not an obvious greeting for a stranger taken to be Solomon; so the whole is uncertain (?). ያበውኡ 'they bring' (አብአ 'bring in', causative of ቦአ; imperfect ያበውእ). አምኃ 'gift'. ጋዳ and መጋዝ (the printed form is መጋዝአ, with the stray final አ, see ch. 33, unit 7) and ምሳሓተ: I cannot place ጋዳ (?) (it may be a misprint of ጋዛ 'treasure', the word of Acts 8:27 discussed in the note to ch. 33, unit 17) (?); መጋዝ is 'storehouse, treasure' (?) (cf. ጋዛ 'treasure' in the previous chapter); ምሳሓተ is 'meals, feasts' (ምሳሕ 'meal, feast') (?). Together: tribute of goods, stores and banquets. ከመ ንጉሦሙ 'as their king' (ንጉሥ + -ሙ).

sentences.i: All the land of Gaza was stirred as far as the region of Judah, and they said: "This is King Solomon."

sentences.i: Some said: "The king is in Jerusalem, building his house;

sentences.n: እስመ ፈጸመ ሐኒጸ 'for he finished building' (ፈጸመ 'complete' + infinitive ሐኒጸ in the accusative, from ሐነጸ). ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'the house of God', i.e. the Temple (1 Kings 6:38; 7:1). sentences.i: The couriers, guardians of the city of Jerusalem, came and found King Solomon there, and bowed to him and said to him:
sentences.n: ወበጽሑ መባርዲን 'and the couriers arrived'. ዐቀብተ ሀገረ ኢየሩሳሌም 'the guards of the city of Jerusalem' (ዐቃቢ 'guard', plural ዐቀብት in the construct). sentences.n: ባሕ ሕየው አበ ነጋሢ repeats the greeting of unit 20; ባሕ is not understood (?). ሀገርሰ ተሀውከት 'the city indeed was stirred' (ሀገር feminine). በእንተ ዘመጽአ ፩ ነጋዲ 'on account of one merchant who came' (በእንተ 'because of', ዘመጽአ 'he who came'); ፩ is 1 (spoken አሐዱ, ʾäḥädu) and ነጋዲ 'merchant', the boy being taken as a merchant of the caravan. ዘይመስል አርአያከ ወአምሳሊከ 'who resembles your form and your likeness' (መሰለ takes an accusative: አርአያ 'appearance, form', አምሳል 'likeness', + -ከ 'your'); which recalls the wording of Genesis 1:26 'our image and likeness' (as I remember the Geʿez Genesis, unchecked). ዘእንበለ ሕፀት ወብዕድና 'without lack and difference' (ሕፀት 'lack, defect', ብዕድና 'otherness, difference'). sentences.n: አዕይንቲሁ ፍሡሓት 'his eyes are glad, bright' (ፍሡሕ 'glad'; feminine plural to agree with the 'eyes'). ከመዘ ሰክረ ወይነ: ከመ + ዘ 'like one who', ሰክረ 'was drunk', ወይነ the accusative of the wine (an accusative of means); the comparison is of shining eyes. ወአቊያጺሁኒ ቈጢጣን: አቊያጺሁ was glossed in ch. 31 as 'his brows (or eyelids)' (?), and I keep that; ቈጢጣን I take as 'arched' (?) from a root of bending, but cannot confirm it. ወማኅፈደ ክሳዲኒ: ማኅፈድ is 'tower' (Dillmann, from memory, unchecked), so 'the tower of his neck, too', a neck like a tower, which recalls Song of Songs 4:4 ('your neck is like the tower of David') and suits 'like the tower of David your father'. sentences.n: ተሀውከ ልቡ 'his heart was troubled' (ተሀውከ with ልብ 'heart' as subject). ወተሐሠየ በመንፈሱ 'and he rejoiced (?) in his spirit' (ተሐሠየ 'he rejoiced, was glad', from the root of ሐሤት 'joy', as ተሐሠየ is glossed in ch. 25–26; the first draft's 'was grieved' is set aside), so 'troubled in heart, glad in spirit', the gladness having its reason in the next clause (he had no grown son) (?). እስመ አልቦ ውሉደ 'for there were no children, he had no sons' (አልቦ 'there is not' + the accusative ውሉድ). ዘእንበለ ሕፃን 'except a child'. ዘ፯ ዓም: ዘ- is the relative, ፯ is 7 (spoken ሰብዐቱ, säbʿätu), and ዓም I take as a short form of ዓመት 'year' (?); 'a child of seven years' or 'who is of seven years'. ዘስሙ ኢዮርብዓም 'whose name is Jeroboam'. sentences.n: This is Solomon's earlier plan (hence 'he had said'). sentences.i: the one who grows is his son, the king of Ethiopia, the son of the Queen of Ethiopia; he is the firstborn of whom it was said in prophecy: God swore to David in truth, and will not repent, that 'from the fruit of your belly I will set one upon your throne';
sentences.n: ዘይልህቅ ወልዱ 'the one who grows is his son' (ልህቀ 'grow up'; ዘይልህቅ the grown one). ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ 'king of Ethiopia', ወልዳ ለንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ 'her son, of the queen of Ethiopia' (ለ- is the possessive linker). በኵር ውእቱ 'he is the firstborn'. ዘይቤ በትንቢት 'which he said in prophecy' introduces the quotation of Psalm 132:11 (131:11 in the Septuagint numbering; also Psalm 89:3–4 and 2 Samuel 7:12): God's oath to David that one of his descendants would sit on his throne. መሐለ እግዚኣብሔር ለዳዊት በጽድቅ ወኢይኔስሕ 'God swore to David in truth, and will not repent' (መሐለ 'swear', ነስሐ 'repent, change one's mind', imperfect ይኔስሕ). ከመ እምፍሬ ከርሥከ ኣነብር ዲበ መንበርከ 'that from the fruit of your belly I will set (one) on your throne' (ፍሬ 'fruit', ከርሥ 'belly, womb'; ኣነብር is the 1st person imperfect with ኣ-, አንበረ 'set, place'). The chronicle reads the oath of the Psalm as pointing to Ethiopian kings too, and to Christ in the next unit.

sentences.l: And-gave-him God favor before-him for-David his-servant, and-gave-him one-who sits on throne-of-divinity from-his-seed in-flesh from virgin, and-judges living-ones and-dead-ones and-repays to-everyone according-to his-deed, to-whom is-fitting glory, to-our-Lord Jesus Christ, for-age-of age, Amen;
sentences.i: God gave David his servant favor before him, and gave him one who would sit on the throne of divinity, from his seed in the flesh, from a virgin, who judges the living and the dead and repays everyone according to his deeds, to whom glory is due, to our Lord Jesus Christ, forever and ever, Amen;
sentences.n: ወወሀቦ እግዚኣብሔር ሞገሰ 'and God gave him favor' (ሞገስ 'grace, favor'; the object -ቦ 'him' is David); በቅድሜሁ 'before him'; ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant' (ገብር 'servant', + -ሁ), alluding to Psalm 132:10 and 89:3. ወወሀቦ ዘይነብር ዲበ መንበረመለኮት: the printed መንበረመለኮት is one word, 'throne-of-divinity' (መንበር 'throne' + መለኮት 'divinity, godhead'); 'one who sits' (ዘይነብር) is Christ. እምዘርኡ በሥጋ እምድንግል 'from his seed in flesh, from a virgin' (the incarnation, Mary being of David's line). ወይኴንን ሕያዋነ ወሙታነ 'and he judges the living and the dead' (ኰነነ 'judge', imperfect ይኴንን; compare 2 Timothy 4:1, Acts 10:42). ወይፈድዮ ለኵሉ በከመ ምግባሩ 'and repays everyone according to his deed' (ፈድየ 'repay'; Romans 2:6, Psalm 62:12). ዘሎቱ ይደሉ ስብሐት 'to whom glory is fitting' (ይደሉ 'it is fitting'), a doxology ending with Amen; ለዓለመ ዓለም 'for ever and ever'. The unit is 29 words, a single long sentence.

sentences.i: And on earth too he gave him one who would be king over the Ark of His law, holy, heavenly Zion, namely the king of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: ወበምድርኒ 'and on earth also' (ምድር 'earth', -ኒ 'also'), set against the heavenly kingship of the previous unit: Christ in heaven, the Ethiopian king on earth. ዘይከውን ንጉሠ ዲበ ታቦተ ሕጉ 'who will be king over the Ark of His law' (ዲበ 'upon, over'). ጽዮን ቅድስት ሰማያዊት 'Zion, holy, heavenly', in apposition: the Ark is Zion (the book's central idea; see ch. 33, unit 11). ዘውእቱ ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ 'who is the king of Ethiopia'. So the chain of the oath runs from David to Christ to the Ethiopian king.

sentences.i: But those who reign, who are not Israel (?) — transgressing the law and the commandment, which God did not will. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: ወእለሰ ይነግሡ 'but those who reign' (እለ plural relative, -ሰ 'indeed, as for'). እለ ኢኮኑ እስራኤል 'who are not Israel, have not become Israel': I take it as a rebuke to the reigning line of Israel as unfaithful, perhaps in the light of Jeroboam's schism (1 Kings 12), but the phrase could also mean 'those not of Israel' (?). ተዐድዎ ሕግ ወትእዛዝ 'transgressing the law and the commandment' (ተዐድዎ the verbal noun of ተዐደወ with its object, as in ch. 9–12 and 13–16 and in the house entry; the alternative, a 3rd plural ተዐደዉ + -ኦ 'they transgressed it', is less likely (?)). ዘኢሠምረ እግዚኣብሔር 'which God did not will, was not pleased with'; whether this describes the law or the transgression is ambiguous (?). The four ፨ close chapter 34 and stay with the final unit.

glossary.በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
glossary.በኵሉ: ኵሉ — in all, by all (በ- + ኵሉ)
glossary.በውእቱ: ውእቱ — in that (በ- + demonstrative, before መዋዕል 'days')
glossary.በዳኅን: ዳኅን — in safety, in health (በ- + noun)
glossary.በጥበቡ: ጥበብ — by his wisdom (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በጽሐ: በጽሐ — he reached, arrived (3ms perfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ባሕ: ባሕ — unidentified; apparently an interjection of greeting before ሕየው (?)
glossary.ባሕቱ: ባሕቱ — but, however, nevertheless (conjunction; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless')
glossary.ባሕቲቱ: ባሕቲት — his solitude, himself alone (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately')
glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house of (noun, construct) · accusative 'a house' (አተወት ቤተ 'she settled in a house') · ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church' (lit. 'house of Christians')
glossary.ብእሲትአ: ብእሲት — woman (noun, fem.; final አ unexplained) (?)
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, abundant (adjective, masc. sg.; written ብዙኀ, adverbial/predicate) · attributive after an accusative noun (ሞገሰ ብዙኀ 'abundant grace')
glossary.ቦሙ: በ — by them, in them (preposition በ- + -ሙ '3mp', ቦሙ)
glossary.ተሀውከ: ተሀውከ — he was troubled (3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ተሀውከት: ተሀውከ — it was stirred (3fs perfect, tä-stem, of the city)
glossary.ተስእልናሆሙ: ተስእለ — we asked them (1cp perfect, tä-stem + -ሆሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ተባዕተ: ተባዕት — male (adjective/noun, accusative; ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons')
glossary.ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
glossary.ተደለው: ተደለወ — prepare yourself! make ready (imperative, tä-stem of ደለወ; 2ms, or 2mp in form) (?)
glossary.ታምልኮ: አምለከ — that she worship him (3fs subjunctive + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትነግሥ: ነግሠ — she reigns, should reign (3fs imperfect/subjunctive, G, n-g-ś)
glossary.ትፈንዎ: ፈነወ — that she send him (3fs subjunctive ትፈንው + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ዎ)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
glossary.ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs')
glossary.ኅጽዋ: ኅጽው — her eunuch (noun + -ኣ '3fs her'); sense of 'eunuch' from Acts 8 (?)
glossary.ነገራ: ነገረ — he told her (3ms perfect, G + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ነጋዲ: ነጋዲ — merchant, trader (noun; agent noun of ነገደ; plural ነጋድያን)
glossary.ነጋድያኒሃ: ነጋዲ — her merchants (plural ነጋድያን + -ሃ '3fs her'; with ኒ inserted before the suffix)
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too')
glossary.ንጉሥሰ: ንጉሥ — the king indeed (noun + ሰ 'indeed, on the other hand')
glossary.አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
glossary.አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
glossary.አእበዳ: አዐበደ — he made foolish (it) (3ms perfect, causative of ዐበደ 'be foolish' + -ኣ '3fs it', anticipating ለጥበበ; spelled አእበዳ) (?)
glossary.አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
glossary.አጽሐበኒ: አጽሐበ — he wearied me, pressed on me (3ms perfect, causative + -ኒ '1cs me'; root and sense from context) (?)
glossary.ኢሐተትናሁ: ሐተተ — we did not question him (ኢ- + 1cp perfect + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢኮኑ: ኮነ — they were not (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኢያውሰበት: አውሰበ — she did not take (as husband) (ኢ- + 3fs perfect, causative of ወሰበ 'marry'; said of a woman taking a husband)
glossary.ኢይስግዱ: ሰገደ — that they not bow down (ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, G)
glossary.ኢይኅድግዎ: ኀደገ — that they not leave him (ኢ- negative + 3mp subjunctive ይኅድጉ + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ዎ)
glossary.ኣነብር: አነበረ — I will set, place (1cs imperfect, causative of ነበረ; written ኣነብር)
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return')
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ)
glossary.እምታሕተ: ታሕተ — from under, under (እም- + preposition ታሕተ)
glossary.እምአድያመ: አድያም — from the regions of (እም- + noun, plural, construct) (?)
glossary.እምዘመድከአ: ዘመድ — from your kin (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your'; final አ unexplained) (?)
glossary.እምዘፈረ: ዘፈር — from the edge, fringe of (እም- + noun, construct); sense guessed from context (?)
glossary.እምዛቲ: ዛቲ — from this (እም- 'from' + feminine demonstrative ዛቲ)
glossary.እምይእዘሰአ: ይእዜ — from now on (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + ሰ 'indeed'; the final አ unexplained) (?)
glossary.እምፍሬ: ፍሬ — from the fruit of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እም፲፻: ፲፻ — from 1000, spoken እምዐሠርቱ ምእት (əm-ʿäśärtu məʾət) 'from ten hundred, a thousand' (እም- 'from' + numeral)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition) · conjunction 'until' before a subjunctive (እስከ ይትፌጸም 'until might be fulfilled')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
glossary.እወልድ: ወለደ — I will beget (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ከመዘ: ከመ — like one who (ከመ + ዘ- 'one who', spelled together as ከመዘ)
glossary.ክሳዲኒ: ክሳድ — his neck also (noun, ክሳዲ- + -ኒ 'also'; the ending ክሳዲ- for ክሳዱ 'his neck' is unexplained, 'his' from context) (?)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
glossary.ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
glossary.ወለሰርጐ: ሰርጕ — and to the adornment of (the heavens, i.e. the stars) (ወ- + ለ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወለትንቢት: ትንቢት — and for prophecy (ወ- + ለ- + noun)
glossary.ወለእመቦ: እመ — and if there is (ወ- + ለእመ conditional + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወለዕፀወ: ዕፅ — and to trees of (ወ- + ለ- + plural construct ዕፀው)
glossary.ወለዘ: ዘ — and to that which (ወ- + ለ- + relative ዘ)
glossary.ወለጥበብከ: ጥበብ — and to your wisdom (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun; construct 'son of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደ ታራ ወልደ 'Terah begot a son'; ch. 13)
glossary.ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
glossary.ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወመዐልተ: መዐልት — and day (ወ- + noun, accusative; adverbial 'by day')
glossary.ወመጋዝአ: መጋዝ — and treasure, storehouse (ወ- + noun; final አ unexplained) (?)
glossary.ወሙታነ: ሙት — and dead ones (ወ- + noun, plural ሙታን, accusative)
glossary.ወማኅፈደ: ማኅፈድ — and tower (?) of (ወ- + noun, construct; 'stature' in ch. 31 is its figurative sense) (?)
glossary.ወምሳሓተ: ምሳሕ — and banquets, meals (ወ- + plural ምሳሓት, accusative)
glossary.ወረከብዎ: ረከበ — and they found him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ዎ)
glossary.ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
glossary.ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
glossary.ወሰገዲ: ሰገደ — and they bowed down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, spelled ሰገዲ for ሰገዱ) (?)
glossary.ወበምድርኒ: ምድር — and on earth also (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወበሥን: ሥን — and in beauty (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበኅይስና: ኅይስና — and in excellence (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun, from ኀየሰ 'be good, excel'); word unclear (?)
glossary.ወበአምኃ: አምኃ — and with gifts (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበውስተ: ውስተ — and within, in (ወ- + በ- + ውስተ)
glossary.ወበጽሑ: በጽሐ — and they arrived (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወብዕድና: ብዕድ — and difference, otherness (ወ- + noun, ብዕድና from ብዕድ 'other') (?)
glossary.ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወተሀውከት: ተሀውከ — and was stirred (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem, of the land)
glossary.ወተሀውኩ: ተሀውከ — and they were troubled (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተሐሠየ: ተሐሠየ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem; cf. ሐሤት 'joy')
glossary.ወተባዕዶ: ተባዕደ — and difference, strangeness (ወ- + verbal noun/infinitive of ተባዕደ 'be strange, other')
glossary.ወተደለወት: ተደለወ — and she prepared (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem of ደለወ 'be ready'; used actively, as ወአስተዳለወት below)
glossary.ወተጋአዙ: ተጋአዘ — and they hurried (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem reciprocal); root and sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ወታበጽሖ: አበጽሐ — and bring him (ወ- + 2ms jussive ታበጽሕ of causative አበጽሐ 'make arrive' + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወታነብራ: አነበረ — and you place it, set it (ወ- + 2ms jussive ታነብር, causative of ነበረ + -ኣ '3fs it')
glossary.ወታገብኦ: አግብአ — and bring him back, restore him (ወ- + 2ms jussive of causative አግብአ + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወትልክኣ: ለአከ — and you send (it) (ወ- + 2ms jussive ትልክ + -ኣ '3fs it'; root ለአከ 'send', sense 'have it written' from context) (?)
glossary.ወትበሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of ይቤ, here spelled ትበ, + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወትቤ: ይቤ — and she said (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of defective ይቤ)
glossary.ወትንበርአ: ነበረ — and it will remain (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G; final አ unexplained) (?)
glossary.ወነሐውር: ሖረ — and we go (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, G)
glossary.ወንቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and we said to them (ወ- + 1cp perfect ንቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወአምሳለ: አምሳል — and likeness of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአምሳሊከ: አምሳል — and your likeness (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወአርትዑ: አርትዐ — and they made straight (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ርትዐ 'be straight')
glossary.ወአስተዳለወት: አስተዳለወ — and she made ready (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative-reflexive of ደለወ)
glossary.ወአቊያጺሁኒ: አቊያጽ — and his brows also (ወ- + noun, plural + -ሁ '3ms his' + -ኒ 'also'); word unclear (?)
glossary.ወአዕዋም: አዕዋም — and trees (?) (ወ- + plural noun; word unidentified, sense from the list of trees and stones) (?)
glossary.ወአዘዘቶሙ: አዘዘ — and she commanded them (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', joined as ቶሙ)
glossary.ወአግሐሠቶ: አግሐሠ — and she drew him aside (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative + -ኦ '3ms him'; root and sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወኢለቀላያት: ቀላይ — and not to seas, depths (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + plural ቀላያት)
glossary.ወኢለአእባን: እብን — and not to stones (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + plural አእባን)
glossary.ወኢለአዕዋፍ: ዖፍ — and not to birds (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + plural አዕዋፍ)
glossary.ወኢለአድባር: ደብር — and not to mountains (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + plural አድባር)
glossary.ወኢለግልፈዋት: ግልፈት — and not to carved images (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + plural ግልፈዋት; singular and exact sense uncertain, as in ch. 13–16) (?)
glossary.ወኢትንገሥአ: ነግሠ — and let not reign (ወ- + ኢ- + 3fs jussive ትንገሥ, G; final አ unexplained) (?)
glossary.ወኢወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he did not give him (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወኢያምልክዎሙ: አምለከ — and that they not worship them (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, denominative of አምላክ + -ሙ '3mp them', joined as ዎሙ)
glossary.ወኢይኔስሕ: ነስሐ — and he will not repent (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect ይኔስሕ, G)
glossary.ወኢይጠየሩ: ጠየረ — and that they not take omens (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive; sense from context, perhaps divination by birds) (?)
glossary.ወኣመዘብር: መዘበረ — and I will plunder, despoil (ወ- + 1cs imperfect of quadriliteral); form irregular (?)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወእሊአሁሰ: እሊአሁ — and his people, companions (ወ- + እሊአ 'those' + -ሁ '3ms his' + ሰ 'indeed') (?)
glossary.ወእወርስ: ወርሰ — and I will inherit, possess (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
glossary.ወኪያከ: ኪያ — and you (ወ- + object pronoun ኪያ + -ka '2ms')
glossary.ወኪዳና: ኪዳን — and her covenant (ወ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወክብሮሙ: ክብር — and their honor, rank (ወ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወወሀበት: ወሀበ — and she gave (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-h-b)
glossary.ወወሀበቶ: ወሀበ — and she gave him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወወሀበቶሙ: ወሀበ — and she gave them (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', joined as ቶሙ)
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወውስዶ: ወሰደ — and take him (ወ- + imperative 2ms ውስድ + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and his seed (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', ዘርኡ)
glossary.ወዘይትወሀብ: ተወሀበ — and which is given, those to be given (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect passive of ወሀበ)
glossary.ወዘይከውን: ኮነ — and which will be (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወያበውኡ: አብአ — and they bring in (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative of ቦአ 'enter')
glossary.ወያግብእዎ: አግብአ — and that they bring him back (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative of ገብአ 'return' + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወይቤሉነ: ብህለ — and they said to us (ወ- + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ + -ነ '1cp to us')
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይኴንን: ኰነነ — and he judges (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ይኴንን)
glossary.ወይፈድዮ: ፈደየ — and he repays (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G ይፈድይ + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወጋዳ: ጋዳ — unidentified word, perhaps a kind of gift (ወ- 'and') (?)
glossary.ወጸውዐቶ: ጸውዐ — and she summoned him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወፈነዉ: ፈነወ — and they sent (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
glossary.ዐቀብተ: ዐቃቢ — guards, guardians of (noun, plural ዐቀብት, construct)
glossary.ዓም: ዓመት — year (noun, contracted ዓም; after a numeral) (?)
glossary.ዘሎቱ: ለ — to whom, whose (ዘ- + preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
glossary.ዘመከረ: መከረ — which took counsel (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘመድከአ: ዘመድ — your kin, your kinsman (noun + -ከ '2ms your'; final አ unexplained) (?)
glossary.ዘመጽአ: መጽአ — who came (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘብርት: ብርት — of/which (ዘ- + ብርት); the word is unidentified, perhaps 'bronze' (cf. ch. 9–12) so 'of bronze' (?)
glossary.ዘተሐንጽ: ሐነጸ — which was built (ዘ- relative + tä-stem 3ms, spelled ተሐንጽ for ተሐንጸ) (?)
glossary.ዘተካየደት: ተካየደ — which she covenanted, made covenant (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, tä-stem reciprocal of ካየደ)
glossary.ዘተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — who transgressed, departed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ)
glossary.ዘአምነ: አምነ — who believed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘኢሠምረ: ሠምረ — which he did not will, was not pleased with (ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
glossary.ዘከረ: ዘከረ — he mentioned, recalled (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘወሀበከ: ወሀበ — which he gave you (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ዘወሀባ: ወሀበ — which he gave her (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object suffix) · which he gave it (feminine object, the city: ሀገር ዘወሀባ ሰሎሞን)
glossary.ዘውስተ: ውስተ — which is in (ዘ- relative + preposition ውስተ)
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዘይልህቅ: ልህቀ — who grows, is great (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ዘይመስል: መሰለ — who resembles (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይሰርር: ሰረረ — which flies (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect); root and sense from context (?)
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዘይትማሰለከ: ተማሰለ — which is like you (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of መሰለ + -ከ '2ms to you')
glossary.ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
glossary.ዘይነብር: ነበረ — who sits, dwells (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ዘ፯: ፯ — of 7, spoken ዘሰብዐቱ (zä-säbʿätu) 'of seven' (ዘ- 'of' + numeral)
glossary.ዝዓለም: ዓለም — this world (ዝ- 'this' + noun; ጥበበ ዝዓለም 'the wisdom of this world')
glossary.የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.የኀሥሥዎ: ኀሠሠ — they seek him, who seek him (3mp imperfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ዎ; after the relative እለ)
glossary.ያእምሮ: አእመረ — that he know him, recognize (3ms subjunctive ያእምር + -ኦ '3ms him', anticipating ለወልዲ; causative stem, root ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ያገብርዎ: አግበረ — that they present him, hand him over (3mp subjunctive, causative of ገብረ 'do' + -ኦ '3ms him'; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ይሢም: ሠየመ — that he appoint, establish (3ms subjunctive, G, ś-y-m; ይሢም is the contracted spelling)
glossary.ይቤሉ: ብህለ — they said (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, b-h-l)
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይንገሥአ: ነግሠ — let him reign (3ms jussive, G; final አ unexplained) (?)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
glossary.ይዘከር: ዘከረ — that he remember (3ms subjunctive; spelled ይዘከር for ይዝክር) (?)
glossary.ይደሉ: ደለወ — it is fitting, due (3m sg imperfect, d-l-w)
glossary.ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct)
glossary.ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant')
glossary.ግብረ: ግብር — deeds, acts of (noun, construct; ግብረ ሐዋርያት 'Acts of the Apostles')
glossary.ጣዖታተ: ጣዖት — idols (noun; plural ጣዖታት, accusative form)
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy')
glossary.ፈነወቶ: ፈነወ — she sent him (3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ፈጣሪነ: ፈጣሪ — our creator (agent noun of ፈጠረ + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ፍጹመ: ፍጹም — perfectly, completely (adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
glossary.፲፻: ፲፻ — 1000, spoken ዐሠርቱ ምእት (ʿäśärtu məʾət) 'ten hundred, a thousand' (numeral)
glossary.፴ወ፫: ፴ወ፫ — 33, spoken ሠላሳ ወሠለስቱ (śälasa wä-śälästu) 'thirty-three'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፴፬: ፴፬ — 34, spoken ሠላሳ ወአርባዕቱ (śälasa wä-ʾärbaʿtu) 'thirty-four'; chapter number (numeral)
